title: Duplicate charge
answer: Sorry about the duplicate charge. We've flagged it to Billing and refunds typically reach your card within 5-7 business days.

title: Invoices and receipts
answer: You can download invoices from Settings > Billing > History. If you need GST details added, send us your GST number and we'll reissue it.

title: Locked account
answer: Please use 'Forgot password' on the sign-in page. If the code or email doesn't arrive within 5 minutes, check spam; we'll unlock your account manually once you confirm your email.

title: Invite teammates
answer: Go to Settings > Members > Invite, enter their emails and pick a role. They'll get an invite link valid for 7 days.

title: Exports and reports
answer: Reports can be exported from Reports > Export. Scheduled exports are available on Pro and Enterprise under Reports > Schedule.

title: Notifications setup
answer: Open Settings > Notifications to choose which events email you or your team, and how often.
